android.notes:
Smaller download and less space used on your phone: frame captures and side-by-side photos are now JPEG (about a tenth the size), voice notes are ~8x smaller, and the app itself is ~2MB lighter.

Saving a clip cut from a camera recording now offers to delete the raw take, with its size named - nothing else pruned Recordings before, and the take is the biggest file the app makes.

Plus startup cleanup of stale temporary files, and assorted fixes.
